blockingIssues.description: JWT signing falls back to a known default secret (change-me-in-production) when JWT_SECRET_KEY is unset, allowing token forgery in misconfigured environments.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/environment.md to align Fernet key naming with implementation (FERNET_KEY) and note dev fallback behavior.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit security rule that auth token signing secrets must never use insecure hardcoded defaults in runtime code; require fail-fast behavior when required secrets are missing outside test contexts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Blocking issue in auth-backend-models-endpoints review: agent/auth.py line 21 default JWT secret enabled forgery risk.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether synchronous FastAPI handlers are permitted for simple I/O-bound endpoints, or enforce async-only with validator checks to avoid ambiguity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Shared-state observation from auth-backend-models-endpoints: AGENTS says async-only, but implemented auth handlers are sync def and still passed validators/tests.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Strengthen self-review checklist to include secret-management anti-pattern checks (e.g., default cryptographic secrets) before final handoff.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Blocking secret fallback passed through implementation and tests in auth-backend-models-endpoints.
